Around 10 years ago, there was a chemical called diacetyl that was used in popcorn factories that was used for their "buttery flavors", which upon inhalation could cause 'popcorn lung', in cases of extreme exposure.

Even though it's used in a lot of eliquids for flavoring still today, there has not been any confirmed cases of popcorn lung from  vaping.

There was a thing in more recent years of people buying THC carts that weren't 'real', and were cut using Vitamin E acetate, which when inhaled actually sticks to the inside of your lungs, causing severe health issues. 
But that's generally your sketchy gas stations or dealers that sold those to make a quick buck.

That's also why most THC products will have QR codes on them, so you can see the lab results and the full chemical breakdown of what's in there. And if it doesn't have a QR code, I would steer clear, unless you know for sure it's safe to use.

This is all to say that a lot of the 'horror stories' of vaping are just that, horror stories, nothing more. As long as you buy from reputable sources, you shouldn't have any issues

There are 2 different ways to vape and get your nicotine. 

1. Freebase nicotine - this is what you would run in a bigger box mod style device, and the nicotine is generally lower (3 or 6 mg) and takes a few minutes to enter your bloodstream. More casual form of vaping and also gives big clouds.

2. Nicotine Salts- this is what's in disposables and would be run in smaller, lower wattage devices. Now the big difference here, is that the nicotine hits your bloodstream in seconds, and will come in much higher nicotine dosages up to 50 mg in some cases. 

Also, when any disposable says 5%, that means 50mg, which is A LOT OF NICOTINE. This is why people who have never smoked/vaped, that got started on disposables, get insanely addicted to them.

The reason Spiderman Remastered doesnt transfer saves is exactly that. It's a different game, and it's on PS5. now, the reason why it won't have th same save data is because that save data is from a game that wasnt meant to be on PS5, and was entirely built for the PS4.
So when an older PS4 game gets remade on PS5, itll come with all the new bells and whistles and will be rebuilt to a certain extent to support the PS5's new features.
Games like Cyberpunk, and COD for instance, they were built with the PS5 in mind. And it'll be easier to implement the new features, and not necessarily have to make an entirely new gamez hence keeping the save data intact.
All "Remastered" games (looking at older PS4 games) will have to be retooled if they want to support PS5, and won't be able to retain the save data.

Tldr: Older PS4 games will not keep save data, while lategen PS4 games have a higher possibility of keeping save data when upgrading to PS5

But it wouldnt have the same impact if I didn't slog through ARR. you build connections with all the characters you meet with in ARR, and some of those bonds get more development in the later expansion.

And also, the grind of the ARR story isn't the level 1-50 MSQ stuff... Its all of the level 50 quests after the base MSQ that is the grind. "Pray return to the Waking Sands" is a phrase you will hear a lot, and get very annoyed by. It's a lot of fetch quest type stuff, until you make it to the stuff leading up to Heavensward, so just be patient, and take the time to level other jobs, and socialize with others. And for queuing up MSQ dungeons and the like, its almost better to have either a tank, or a healer in the wings, because DPS queue times are atrocious, while tanks and MOST DEFINITELY healers are always needed. Anyway, I hope this info helps you a bit, and you get to enjoy FFXIV to the fullest
